_comment: GroundingDINO + Meta SAM. GD turns text prompts ('road. building.') into labelled bboxes; SAM masks them; we emit one bbox Detection per mask using GD's label. First run downloads GD-tiny (~700MB) from HF and SAM ViT-B (~375MB) from Meta. CPU is workable at 1536px long-side; for larger imagery raise max_long_side_px and expect proportional slowdown.
